incidents-bot: ALERT: Customers reporting duplicated embedding usage and occasional duplicate embed results. Investigating. Live status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2071239999-metering-ingest

sam-sre: Quick summary: telemetry publisher v3.1 introduced lax idempotence. Under high-backpressure some events were re-published -> duplicate metering entries (~1%).

eva-telemetry: Rolling back publisher to v3.0.8 now; paused non-critical producers. Canary started in eu-central-1 zone-a. ETA ~10m.

mike-billing: Pausing invoice generation for the affected ingestion window and preparing automated credits if duplicates confirmed. Billing hold ID: bh-2071239999.

anya-support: Draft status note pinned in #support-ops: "We are investigating duplicated embedding events and have paused billing for the affected window. We will apply credits for confirmed duplicates and update within 30 minutes."

sam-sre: Mitigations done: rollback started 2071240102, producer pause 2071240120, dedupe backfill queued (job dedupe-2071239999).

eva-telemetry: Canary rollback healthy at 2071240325, duplicate event rate down ~80% there. Rolling to remaining zones. Backfill will de-duplicate using event-hash+seq checks.

anya-support: Support copy: "Thanks — we detected duplicate embedding events and paused billing for the window. We're running an automated reconciliation and will credit affected accounts. Share request IDs if you see duplicate responses. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2071239999-metering-ingest"

sam-sre: Current ETA for full mitigation 30-60m. If duplicates persist after 2071240500, escalate to on-call with traces. Next update in 20m or on significant change.
